detail.body:
# What does this PR do ?

This PR aims to migrate GLM-5 series models arch from legacy `GPTModel` to new `HybridModel`.

# Changelog

- `glm5_bridge.py`: register `target=HybridModel, provider=GLM5ModelProvider`; derive `hybrid_layer_pattern` / `moe_layer_freq` from the HF config; `megatron_to_hf_config` maps 156 physical layers back to 78 HF layers; MTP mappings target the `/DE` MTP pattern; `hf_config_to_model_config` raises `ModelConfigNotSupportedError` instead of silently building a GPT model.
- `glm5_provider.py` (new `GLM5ModelProvider(HybridModelProvider, MLATransformerConfig)`): validates the `D-/DE` pattern, auto-splits pipeline stages on DSA compute layers so index-sharing groups stay whole (`split_glm_pattern`), rejects VPP and selective `core_attn` recompute, enables `sequence_parallel` for TP>1 (AbsorbedMLA requirement), derives physical `num_layers` / `moe_layer_freq` and the MTP override pattern.
- `glm5_hybrid.py` (new): `GLMHybridStack` rescales the HF index-sharing cadence to physical layer coordinates and replays a whole stage under full recompute; `GLMHybridMTPLayer` reuses the same stage runner for the nested MTP stack; private `glm_hybrid_stack_spec`.
- `glm5_hybrid.py`: forward-local DSA top-k state is scoped with a `ContextVar` read by a thin `GLMDSAttention` subclass instead of attributes injected on mask/packed-seq/config carriers.
- `training/model_load_save.py`: single-rank flex→allgather dispatcher fallback also disables `moe_shared_expert_overlap`.
- `training/utils/flop_utils.py`: reuse the DSA FLOPs estimator in logical coordinates for `D-/DE` hybrid patterns (incl. MTP and top-k reuse).
- Recipes (`recipes/glm/{h100,gb200}`, `perf_recipes/glm_moe_dsa/{h100,gb200}`): explicit per-stage `block_counts` via `split_glm_pattern`; VPP disabled.
- Tests: bridge/provider/recipe/FLOPs unit tests updated for the Hybrid layout; new `test_glm5_provider.py`; functional toy conversion adds the GLM-5.2 index-share strict round-trip and checks HF config keeps the logical layer count.
- Model cards + docs (`glm5`, `glm5-2`): GB200-only; verified on real checkpoints with the Hybrid path — GPU import, GPU/CPU export (bit-exact vs. source, MTP excluded by default) and deterministic legacy full-prefix inference; H100 entries removed, `manual_forward_pass` and training items remain unverified.

Breaking: GPT-layout GLM checkpoints and optimizer states are not migration inputs — re-import from the pinned HF revision into a fresh Hybrid checkpoint root.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [ ] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation?
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

If you haven't finished some of the above items you can still open "Draft" PR.

# Additional Information

- Related to # (issue)

+
+import copy
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from contextvars import ContextVar
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_block import HybridStack
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_allocation import validate_segment_layers
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_specs import hybrid_stack_spec
+from megatron.core.packed_seq_params import PackedSeqParams
+from megatron.core.transformer.experimental_attention_variant.dsa import DSAttention
+from megatron.core.transformer.experimental_attention_variant.dsa_layer_config import DSALayerConfig
+from megatron.core.transformer.multi_token_prediction import MultiTokenPredictionLayer
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.utils import WrappedTensor
+
+
+# Per-forward DSA index-sharing state: (top-k holder, top-k length holder).
+_FORWARD_STATE: ContextVar[tuple[dict[int, torch.Tensor], dict[int, torch.Tensor]] | None] = ContextVar(
+    "glm_dsa_forward_state", default=None
+)
+
+
+class GLMDSAttention(DSAttention):
+    """Read index-sharing state from the enclosing GLM stage forward instead of carrier attributes."""
+
+    def _get_index_share_topk_holder(
+        self, packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams | None, attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    ) -> dict[int, torch.Tensor]:
+        state = _FORWARD_STATE.get()
+        if state is None:
+            return super()._get_index_share_topk_holder(packed_seq_params, attention_mask)
+        return state[0]
+
+    def _get_index_share_topk_length_holder(
+        self, packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams | None, attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    ) -> dict[int, torch.Tensor]:
+        state = _FORWARD_STATE.get()
+        if state is None:
+            return super()._get_index_share_topk_length_holder(packed_seq_params, attention_mask)
+        return state[1]
+
+
+def _forward_glm_stack(stack: HybridStack, hidden_states: Any, attention_mask: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not stack.pre_process:
+        # Non-first pipeline stages receive ``None`` here; the real input arrives
+        # through ``set_input_tensor``. Resolve it now so the checkpoint below sees
+        # the tensor that requires grad instead of ``None``.
+        hidden_states = stack.input_tensor
+    if isinstance(hidden_states, WrappedTensor):
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.unwrap()
+
+    def run(value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # One fresh state per stage invocation, including each checkpoint replay,
+        # so outstanding microbatches never reuse each other's top-k indices.
+        token = _FORWARD_STATE.set(({}, {}))
+        saved_input = stack.input_tensor
+        try:
+            if not stack.pre_process:
+                # HybridStack.forward ignores ``value`` on these stages and reads
+                # ``input_tensor``; point it at ``value`` so the checkpoint replay
+                # consumes the detached copy and gradients flow through the checkpoint.
+                stack.input_tensor = value
+            return HybridStack.forward(stack, value, attention_mask, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            stack.input_tensor = saved_input
+            _FORWARD_STATE.reset(token)
+
+    if stack.config.recompute_granularity == "full" and stack.training:
+        # Replay each sharing group together with fresh native DSA state.
+        def recompute(value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            original = stack.config
+            stack.config = copy.copy(original)
+            stack.config.recompute_granularity = None
+            try:
+                return run(value)
+            finally:
+                stack.config = original
+
+        return tensor_parallel.checkpoint(recompute, stack.config.distribute_saved_activations, hidden_states)
+    return run(hidden_states)
+
+
+class GLMHybridStack(HybridStack):
+    """Isolate top-k state by forward and replay a complete stage on recomputation."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Any,
+        submodules: Any,
+        *,
+        layer_config_list: Any = None,
+        layer_type_list: list[str] | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        if layer_config_list is None and layer_type_list is not None:
+            layer_config_list = validate_segment_layers("".join(layer_type_list), config)
+            layer_type_list = None
+        if layer_config_list is not None:
+            converted = []
+            for layer_config in layer_config_list:
+                layer_config = copy.copy(layer_config)
+                if isinstance(layer_config, DSALayerConfig) and (layer_config.dsa_indexer_topk_freq or 1) > 1:
+                    # DSA occupies physical layers 1, 3, 5, ... in D-/DE pairs.
+                    # Express the HF cadence in those coordinates without changing
+                    # provider/HF metadata.
+                    layer_config.dsa_indexer_topk_freq *= 2
+                    layer_config.dsa_indexer_skip_topk_offset = (
+                        2 * max(layer_config.dsa_indexer_skip_topk_offset or 0, 1) - 1
+                    )
+                converted.append(layer_config)
+            layer_config_list = converted
+        super().__init__(
+            config, submodules, layer_config_list=layer_config_list, layer_type_list=layer_type_list, **kwargs
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: Any, attention_mask: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run the stage with fresh state, including during backward recomputation."""
+        return _forward_glm_stack(self, hidden_states, attention_mask, **kwargs)
+
+
+class GLMHybridMTPLayer(MultiTokenPredictionLayer):
+    """Use the same forward-scoped state for Core's nested MTP HybridStack."""
+
+    def _proj_and_transformer_layer(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, decoder_input: torch.Tensor, **kwargs: Any
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # BF16 GLM only: retain Core's projection/RNG/post-norm behavior, but use
+        # the GLM stage runner because Core constructs nested stacks directly.
+        rng = tensor_parallel.get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork() if self.config.sequence_parallel else nullcontext()
+        with rng:
+            hidden_states = self._concat_embeddings(hidden_states, decoder_input)
+            hidden_states = _forward_glm_stack(
+                self.mtp_model_layer,
+                hidden_states,
+                kwargs.get("attention_mask"),
+                padding_mask=kwargs.get("padding_mask"),
+                rotary_pos_emb=kwargs.get("rotary_pos_emb"),
+                inference_context=kwargs.get("inference_params"),
+                packed_seq_params=kwargs.get("packed_seq_params"),
+                packed_seq_params_by_layout=kwargs.get("packed_seq_params_by_layout"),
+                cp_layout_plan=kwargs.get("cp_layout_plan"),
+            )
+        return self._postprocess(hidden_states)
+
+
+def glm_hybrid_stack_spec(config: Any) -> ModuleSpec:
+    """Return a private GLM spec without mutating Core's shared specification."""
+    spec = copy.deepcopy(hybrid_stack_spec)
+    spec.module = GLMHybridStack
+    # The nested MTP stack is built from the same dsa_layer submodules.
+    spec.submodules.dsa_layer.submodules.self_attention.submodules.core_attention.module = GLMDSAttention
+    for layer_spec in spec.submodules.mtp_block_spec.submodules.layer_specs:
+        layer_spec.module = GLMHybridMTPLayer
+    return spec

+def _partition_layer_groups(group_sizes: list[int], num_stages: int) -> list[int]:

+        count, load = 1, 0
+        for size in group_sizes:
+            if load + size > capacity:
+                count, load = count + 1, 0
+            load += size
+        return count

+    capacity = max(group_sizes)
+    while stages_needed(capacity) > num_stages:
+        capacity += 1

+    stage_sizes: list[int] = []

**Blocking: this verified `manual_forward_pass` command can't run through `infer.sh`.** The same applies to [glm5-2 card L103-106](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/fafe304122c7acbd7eebd6e3dbb3566abab436b9/examples/model_verification_cards/glm5-2/card.yaml#L103-L106).

**Failure**
- `infer.sh` execs `setup_inference.py`.
- `main()` calls [`_validate_task_args`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/fafe304122c7acbd7eebd6e3dbb3566abab436b9/scripts/inference/setup_inference.py#L213-L219) before building the executor.
- That function raises `ValueError("--legacy-full-prefix requires --task legacy-full-prefix-generation.")` whenever the flag is used with any other task.
- So `--task model-comparison ... --legacy-full-prefix` exits with that error and never submits a job.
- The new [`compare.py --legacy-full-prefix`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/fafe304122c7acbd7eebd6e3dbb3566abab436b9/examples/conversion/compare_hf_and_megatron/compare.py#L1230-L1237) can't be reached through the public launcher. The model-verification-card skill requires that launcher.
- The same command is copied into `catalog-v1.json` and the four generated GLM doc pages.

Expected: the flag reaches `compare.py`, which runs the plain full-prefix forward that the card records.

**Correction** in `scripts/inference/setup_inference.py`:
```python
_LEGACY_FULL_PREFIX_TASKS = frozenset({"legacy-full-prefix-generation", "model-comparison"})


def _validate_task_args(task_name: str, inference_args: list[str]) -> None:
    """Validate arguments owned by a selected inference task."""
    uses_legacy_full_prefix = "--legacy-full-prefix" in inference_args
    if task_name == "legacy-full-prefix-generation" and not uses_legacy_full_prefix:
        raise ValueError("--task legacy-full-prefix-generation requires --legacy-full-prefix.")
    if uses_legacy_full_prefix and task_name not in _LEGACY_FULL_PREFIX_TASKS:
        raise ValueError(
            "--legacy-full-prefix requires --task legacy-full-prefix-generation or --task model-comparison."
        )
```

Invariant: `--legacy-full-prefix` is accepted only for task scripts that define it. Those are `hf_to_megatron_generate_text.py` and now `compare.py`.

This changes shared launcher infrastructure, so the card skill also asks for a short justification in the PR description. The alternative is to keep both `manual_forward_pass` items `unverified` until a launcher-runnable command exists.

**Preserve**
- `legacy-full-prefix-generation` still requires the flag.
- `text-generation`, `vlm-generation` and `hf-inference` still reject it, because their scripts don't define it.
- `model-comparison` without the flag is unchanged and still builds a `StaticInferenceContext`.

**Acceptance** (proposed tests in `tests/unit_tests/scripts/inference/test_setup_inference.py`)
- Keep both cases of `test_task_validation_rejects_inconsistent_legacy_full_prefix_usage`. The new message still matches `requires --task legacy-full-prefix-generation`.
- Add `("vlm-generation", ["--legacy-full-prefix"], ...)` and `("hf-inference", ["--legacy-full-prefix"], ...)` rejection cases.
- New `test_task_validation_allows_legacy_full_prefix_model_comparison`: `module._validate_task_args("model-comparison", ["--legacy-full-prefix"])` and `module._validate_task_args("model-comparison", [])` both return without raising.

reviews.body:
<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

## Review: Migrate GLM from GPTModel to HybridModel (light, broad)

I reviewed all 43 changed files. For the 33 files left out of the inline diff, I compared head against base directly. The core migration looks correct:
- **Provider:** pattern derivation, the PP split that keeps each DSA sharing group whole, and the rejections for VPP and selective `core_attn` recompute.
- **Bridge:** the 156↔78 layer coordinate mapping and the `/DE` MTP mappings.
- **FLOPs:** the estimator in logical coordinates.
- **Recipes:** the `split_glm_pattern` block counts sum to 78 and start every stage on a compute layer.
- **Conversion:** distributed CPU import validation in `run_conversion`/`setup_conversion`.
- **Scripts:** `compare.py` `_build_inference_context` and the `verify_hf_inference.py --tp-plan` path.

I also re-derived the training throughput numbers recorded in both cards from tokens per step, step time and GPU count. They are consistent.

**Prior review comment, now fixed.** cuichenx's point on `glm5_hybrid.py` ("`value` could be None on non-first pipeline stages") is fixed in head. [`_forward_glm_stack`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/fafe304122c7acbd7eebd6e3dbb3566abab436b9/src/megatron/bridge/models/glm_moe_dsa/glm5_hybrid.py#L61-L84) now resolves `stack.input_tensor` before the checkpoint. It also points `input_tensor` at the checkpointed `value` during the run and restores it afterwards. `test_non_first_stage_full_recompute_keeps_autograd_graph` and `test_run_restores_input_tensor_when_stage_forward_raises` cover this.

### Findings
1. **Blocking (moderate impact):** both cards' `manual_forward_pass` commands (`infer.sh --task model-comparison ... --legacy-full-prefix`) fail before any job is submitted. `setup_inference._validate_task_args` only accepts `--legacy-full-prefix` with `--task legacy-full-prefix-generation`. As a result, these "verified" entries can't be reproduced with the public launcher, and the new `compare.py --legacy-full-prefix` flag can't be reached through it. (Inline comment on the glm5 card.)
2. **Non-blocking (low):** the new "HybridModel migration" doc section still says GPU round-trip, parity, MTP, packed CP, training and Hybrid resume "require fresh verification". The same PR records all of these as verified. The text appears in four doc pages. The PR description has the same mismatch: it says `manual_forward_pass` and training remain unverified.
3. **Non-blocking (low):** both card summaries (and the catalog copies) say model-level checks "retain their historical NeMo 26.08.rc3 records". In fact those items were re-run on the Hybrid path in `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3`.
4. **Non-blocking (low):** the conversion README's intro and its export section still describe distributed CPU conversion as export-only.
5. **Non-blocking (low, missing test):** nothing tests the new `gpu_backend.import_checkpoint(use_cpu=True)` path, which uses Gloo/CPU init and rejects `--low-memory-save`.
6. **Non-blocking (low, outdated docstring):** `test_glm5_h100_parallel_topology` still documents VPP2 while asserting VPP is `None`.

The proposed tests and patches below come from reading the source; I could not run them in this review. Please verify any suggested code before adopting it.

### Suggested test cases
This repository has no `scripts/performance/configs/` tree; the perf recipes live under `src/megatron/bridge/perf_recipes/glm_moe_dsa/`. So I list the affected perf and library recipe factories by exact name instead of `_perf` case names.
